title: Light Briny French Green Beans Gratin
description: A quick and flavorful French dish featuring green beans in a briny sauce, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This satvik-friendly recipe is made with fresh green beans and a mortar-pestle-pound sauce.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and blanch the green beans for 4 minutes.
Shock the green beans in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the garlic and salt until well combined.
Add the black pepper, parsley, and grated cheese to the mortar and pestle and pound until well combined.
In a saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat and add the pounded garlic mixture.
Stir in the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
In individual mini cocottes, arrange a layer of green beans, followed by a spoonful of the garlic cream sauce.
Repeat the layering process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
